# Next Revolution Tech (NRT)

> Next Revolution Tech is a global technology partner and enterprise software engineering consultancy specializing in custom ERP systems, AI workflow automation, agentic AI solutions, staff augmentation, and scalable cloud ecosystems.

## Core Enterprise Services
- [Enterprise Services](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/services): Custom ERP Systems, AI Workflow Automation, Dedicated Technology Teams.
- [Tech Stack & Architecture](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/tech-stack): Enterprise stack (React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, Python, PostgreSQL, AWS, Agentic AI).
- [Discovery Framework](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/discovery-framework): 5-phase software architecture & project delivery framework.
- [Cost Estimator Engine](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/estimator): Interactive software project estimation engine.
- [Dedicated Engineering Teams](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/dedicated-teams): Pre-vetted React, Node.js, and AI engineers for staff augmentation.

## Enterprise Case Studies
- [Pulse Healthcare ERP](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/case-studies/pulse-healthcare-erp): Multi-tenant HIPAA-compliant ERP system for US healthcare provider.
- [Autonomous AI Router](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/case-studies/autonomous-ai-agent): 24/7 lead qualification agentic AI router.
- [Textile Mill Web POS](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/case-studies/textile-mill-pos): Industrial Web POS with live FBR tax API integration.

## Proprietary Frameworks
- [The NRT Digital Transformation Framework™](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/resources/nrt-digital-transformation): A proprietary 7-stage methodology for digitizing enterprise operations without disrupting current cash flow.

## Industry Solutions & ERP Architectures
- [Construction & Real Estate ERP](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/solutions/construction-erp): Manage projects, track site inventory, and control budgets with a specialized Construction ERP.
- [Distribution & Trading ERP](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/solutions/distribution-erp): Streamline your supply chain, automate procurement, and optimize warehouse operations with a custom Distribution ERP.
- [Hospital Management System (HMIS)](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/solutions/hospital-erp): Secure, compliant, and integrated ERP systems for modern healthcare facilities and multi-specialty hospitals.
- [Logistics & Fleet ERP](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/solutions/logistics-erp): Optimize routes, track fleet maintenance, and automate dispatching with a custom Logistics ERP.
- [Manufacturing ERP Systems](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/solutions/manufacturing-erp): Next-generation Enterprise Resource Planning for modern manufacturing facilities, integrating shop floor data with top-level financial insights.
- [Pharma ERP Solution](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/solutions/pharma-erp): Comprehensive ERP solution tailored for the pharmaceutical industry to ensure compliance and traceability.
- [Retail & Point of Sale (POS) ERP](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/solutions/retail-erp): Omnichannel retail software connecting physical storefronts, e-commerce, and warehouse inventory in real-time.
- [Rice Mill ERP Systems](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/solutions/rice-mill-erp): Specialized ERP software for Rice Mills to track paddy procurement, milling yield, and inventory.
- [School & University ERP](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/solutions/school-erp): Digital campus management systems designed to streamline admissions, academics, and administration.
- [Textile & Apparel ERP](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/solutions/textile-erp): End-to-end manufacturing software for spinning, weaving, dyeing, and garment production.

## Enterprise Problem Solutions
- [Manual Invoicing and Accounts Payable Overload](https://www.nextrevolutiontech.tech/business-problems/manual-invoicing): Finance teams spending hours manually typing invoice data into ERPs, resulting in late payments, high error rates, and employee burnout.
